title: The retro asks GPT-6.2 Astra to critique every slice that hit a workaround
body:
Operator 2026-11-17: "zacznij częściej pytać Astrę 6.2 o zdanie", to polish recurring friction instead of working around it. Today the lead only asks Astra by hand (.krn/runs/research/gpt-6-2/RUN.md: codex exec -m gpt-6.2-astra -o ...). This session hit four workarounds in one slice (egress socket path, ambient KRN_SESSION_CLASS in tests, ship scoped check without PR_BODY, Agent isolation vs lane worktrees).
Files: scripts/claude/astra-critique.ts, .claude/skills/delivery-retro/SKILL.md
Outcome: one command sends a slice's friction log (blockers, refusals, workarounds with evidence paths) to codex exec -m gpt-6.2-astra read-only and writes its critique under .krn/runs/research/gpt-6-2/critique-<date>.md; delivery-retro runs it whenever the slice recorded a workaround or a tool refusal, and each finding gets a task or a disposition.
Proof: node scripts/claude/astra-critique.ts --dry-run prints the exact codex command and the friction log it would send, exit 0.
